metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with Textured Borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A four-person group portrait framed by a wide, speckled gray border. The central image features dramatic, cool-toned studio lighting against a textured blue-gray backdrop. The subjects exhibit 1980s styling with voluminous hair and layered clothing, arranged in a tight, multi-level composition. Typography is placed in the upper margin, utilizing high-contrast serifs and wide letter-spacing.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the flat, speckled border and the depth of the central photograph
Tight triangular arrangement of the four subjects within the frame
Repetition of cool blue and gray tones across the background and clothing
Juxtaposition of lowercase display text with uppercase subtitle text
coreInvariants: A thick, speckled gray outer frame
Dramatic side-lighting creating high-contrast shadows on faces
Wide letter-spacing in the upper right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the lower 75% of the frame, arranged from the bottom center to the middle-left and middle-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blonde subject in the lower-left foreground acts as the primary focal point due to hair brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright hair in the foreground, up to the two male figures in the back, then across to the rightmost figure, and finally to the text in the top margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top 25% of the composition is reserved for the speckled border and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grays and muted blues define the background and border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in clothing and shadows provide structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and blonde/red hair highlights provide the only organic warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the lighting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Modern serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin hairlines and thick stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Lowercase high-contrast serif for the main title paired with a smaller, all-caps serif for the subtitle.
graphicDevices: Speckled texture overlay on the border
Inset rectangular frame for the photograph

preserve: Lowercase styling for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Appropriate for the secondary uppercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four people with 1980s hairstyles and fashion. Use dramatic side-lighting and a textured blue-gray studio backdrop. Frame the entire image with a wide, light gray border that has a fine granite-like speckled texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase text in a high-contrast serif font (like Didot) centered in the top border with wide tracking. Add a smaller line of uppercase serif text in the top right corner of the border.

verificationChecks: Is the border wide and speckled?
Is the main title text entirely lowercase?
Is the lighting on the subjects high-contrast and directional?
Is the color palette dominated by cool grays and blues?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue hue in the backdrop
mustRedesign: The 'Compact Disc' technical logo in the corner
Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Consistent speckled texture on the border

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the central image.
Ensure the border texture looks like stone or grain, not digital noise.
Verify the subjects' hair has the characteristic volume of the mid-80s.
Confirm the lowercase 't' in the title is stylized correctly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast group portrait with a wide, textured margin and minimalist, wide-tracked serif typography for a classic new wave aesthetic.
